products.name: CASB & Cloud App Control with Netskope — Commercial
products.short_description: Deliver CASB and cloud app control with Netskope — discover sanctioned and shadow-IT cloud apps, score risk, and apply inline and API controls so cloud usage is visible and governed without blocking the business. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
See and control every cloud app your people use — sanctioned or not

Your people use hundreds of cloud apps, most of which IT never approved, and corporate data flows into them unseen. This solution delivers CASB and cloud app control with Netskope — discover sanctioned and shadow-IT cloud apps, score their risk, and apply inline and API-based controls (allow, restrict, coach, block, and data-movement policy) so cloud usage is visible and governed without blocking the business.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how Netskope CASB works (inline and API), cloud app discovery and risk scoring, the control levers (allow/restrict/coach/block, activity and data controls), and the govern-without-blocking approach.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Netskope tenant + CASB, steering/SWG in place, Entra ID identity, API connections to sanctioned apps, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: discover and risk-score cloud apps, define sanctioned/unsanctioned policy, apply inline activity controls and API controls for sanctioned apps, validate, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — cloud-app discovery readiness, control-policy validation, a cloud-app usage and risk report, safe remediation of policy gaps, and a CASB-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every cloud app visible and governed — shadow IT discovered and risk-scored, with inline and API controls that protect data without blocking the business — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • NSCASB-Discovery.ps1 — cloud-app inventory signal and CASB readiness (read-only)
    • NSCASB-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation of CASB scoping/coverage gaps (defaults to -WhatIf)
    • NSCASB-Report.ps1 — cloud-app usage and risk report (read-only)
    • NSCASB-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/maintain the CASB scope groups in Entra ID
    • NSCASB-Validation.ps1 — CASB readiness and pilot-scoping validation (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
